thesis: The best-published capacity price on the platform, secured one year at a time, and the reference project falls short of the fund's target. Four hours is the best design as accreditation erodes. Wait for the 2029/30 auction in December 2026 before pricing anything.
本平台公开最充分的容量价格，但只能逐年锁定，参考项目达不到基金目标回报。随着认证系数下降，四小时仍是最佳设计。在2026年12月2029/30交付年拍卖之前，不对任何资产定价。

reason: 2026-11-10: Retain the current grade and Wait call. Fair evidence: the existing hold-return fifth rule uses the base operating comparison, before the investment card's separate tax and financing treatment. The approved duration-specific renewal ELCC path explains the change from the historical design return; forward prices remain scenarios and later ELCC indications are non-binding. Read current returns from their respective model results. Recheck when the next auction price and updated accreditation are available; the earlier dated rationale remains in history.
2026-11-10：维持现有评级及Wait判断。证据中等：既定持有回报五分位规则采用基础运营比较口径，不含投资卡片另行计入的税务和融资处理。已批准的分时长续期ELCC路径解释了与历史设计回报的差异；远期价格仍为情景，后续ELCC指示值不具约束力。当前回报以各自模型结果为准；取得下一次拍卖价格及更新认证后复核，原有日期的依据保留在历史中。
